notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
description:
Cast Proud Pack-Rhino by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Proud Pack-Rhino spell three times.
Resolve the first Proud Pack-Rhino spell.
When the Proud Pack-Rhino token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
